discordPostHtml:
A pack of 45 new weeb AI portraits added directly into player faction for easy use.
Comes with 15 Nia's AI portraits for player as a bonus (so 60 in total).

Note: This does not replace any portraits anywhere, it only adds new ones to the player faction.

v1.3.0 Changelog
- Version change to 0.97 (wow much intelligence required)
- 9 new HOT MEN portraits
- Nia's RAT Neuro Core
- Some portrait renaming for consistency. Old name portraits are still there for this version (loaded but removed from faction, so they don't generate and can't be selected), but will be removed in the next. It is so people can update mid-save without having npcs and officers suddenly lose their face, but to also filter out the portraits in favour of new names. Hopefully by the time next proper update is in order, people will move on to new saves.
